description: Laid the loaf end to the window, and asked after the children.
name: Alse Pinder

description: Measured the loaf, asked once, and kept the drawing off her board.
name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

description: Lay on the second volume and was not moved.
name: Gib

description: Reported the frame, the money, and the porch, and refused the rest of the letter.
name: William Shakespeare
